policy.weights: Nine row-major integer weights in [0,1000000], positive total, openly normalized
policy.coordinates: Rows U and columns V each [-1,0,1]; X=xScale*U+xShift, Y=yScale*V+yShift
policy.parameters: Finite numeric scales/shifts bounded by 1000000 with at most two decimal places
policy.exact: Reduced num/den strings; centered moments independently checked against second moments
policy.conditional: Rows describe V given U; columns describe U given V; null for zero primitive marginal
policy.independence: Independence of transformed X,Y, hence true if either scale is zero
policy.correlation: Binary64 covariance/sqrt(varX*varY); null if either variance is zero; scaled tolerance 2e-12
